title: New house, a dog and learning to drive
summary: With the house done they got a puppy and discussed a Cadillac and teaching him to drive; Pete Johnson looked on.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: In two weeks' time, I was livin' in the house with ever'thing spank brand new. So we went to the dogpound. She wanted a dog. So we went to the dogpound and try to find a dog. Didn't see none that suit her. So a friend o' hers said she's puppies...her dog had had some puppies so she went over there and picked out one of the puppies. So she brought the puppy home.
say, "Now we all set. We got a house, we got us a dog, you got a Cadillac car...now all I need is a car for ma...for myself but I don't know how to drive."

say, "Well, I'll learn you how to drive. No, I better not. It ain't gonna work out too good 'cause we be arguin' an' I'll be... get somebody else to tryin' that...get Pete Johnson to learn you how to drive." Say, "He don't know how to drive so good but he could teach ya."
So, the meantime, Pete Johnson sittin' back with his mouth wide open. He didn't like that at all. He didn't dig that at all.
